method: All issue/comment narratives reviewed for findings and corrections. Embedded source-code attachments were not re-audited as implementations; no new behavior or parity is certified.

hashing.bodySha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 issue body; null is empty text.
hashing.orderedCommentsSha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON array of {id,bodySha256}, ordered by created_at then id. Comment bodies use the same UTF-8 rule. JSON uses sorted keys, ensure_ascii=False and comma/colon separators without spaces.
